create_scannetpp_dataset: create a ScanNetpp dataset instance with a ROOT path and resolution for training
load_scannetpp_metadata: load preprocessed ScanNet++ metadata including scenes, images, intrinsics, and camera trajectories from npz file
get_stereo_views: get a pair of stereo views with RGB images, depthmaps, and camera poses for a given index
review_ScanNetpp_class: review the ScanNetpp class that extends BaseStereoViewDataset for loading ScanNet++ stereo image pairs
run_scannetpp_visualization: run the ScanNet++ dataset visualization to display point clouds and camera poses for stereo pairs
